title: GitHub Classic personal access token: one-property twin (length)
summary: 3 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value's length differs from the contracted length. Legacy mutation notes: length: 35 vs contracted 36. Twin of "GitHub Classic personal access token: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of ghp-1: length: 35 vs contracted 36. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
